quest.title: Cleanup At Dawn
quest.description: After the storm, head housemaid Adelinde is preparing to render the Dawn Winery spick and span on the inside and out, but things aren't going so smoothly...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Tea Break Pancake x5

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can help.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Do you know how to sweep? Actually, scrap that, we're so short-staffed that I should be taking all the help I can get.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Follow me indoors, there's plenty of cleaning that needs doing in there, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm an excellent sweeper.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Really? That's wonderful. Well, since you're willing, I'll gladly take you up on the offer.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Follow me indoors, there's plenty of cleaning that needs doing in there, too.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Finished?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All done.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Wonderful, this was a huge help. I can't imagine how long this would have taken me by myself.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: And if I'd gotten the girls to do it... Who knows how many items they'd end up destroying in the process...

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Thank you, please take these. I do apologize for troubling you, a visitor, with the work of a Winery maid.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Next time you visit, the Winery will be spotless.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Clean the place again, and I want it spotless this time! This is about making a good first impression!

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Sorry, Ms. Adelinde!

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: We'll be more careful this time, Ms. Adelinde!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Ah, hello, Traveler. Welcome to the Dawn Winery. The storm may have passed, but here at the Winery we're still cleaning up the mess it made.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: I'm trying to organize the cleanup operation, but these girls, they—

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Sorry, Ms. Adelinde!

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: We'll be more careful this time, Ms. Adelinde!

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Yes, you've said that already, thank you very much! Now, why don't you put your efforts into cleaning instead of standing here apologizing to me? Shoo!

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: These kids... Ugh, they're so sloppy. I don't know how we'll ever get through it all at their rate of progress. And even after that, there's still the indoors that needs cleaning.

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Ugh, the Winery is just too big. How are we supposed to clean the whole place?

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: After cleaning the outside, there's still the inside to do. Are we ever gonna get this place clean...

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: It's so wonderful that you are able to help out. I know I have Moco and Hillie, but... *sigh* they're more a hindrance, to be honest...

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Ugh, the Winery is just too big. How are we supposed to clean the whole place?

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: After cleaning the outside, there's still the inside to do. Are we ever gonna get this place clean...
